integrity: All geometric and probability assertions are proved directly in RESULT.md, apart from routine Euclidean geometry and the elementary integral. The reproducibility program uses only Python standard-library components; no external paper text is reproduced.
scientific_limitations: The exact cubic law is asserted only for a sufficiently small radius depending on the fixed nondegenerate convex polygon. Independent audit has not been performed; historical equivalents may be unindexed. Numerical tests supplement but do not replace the analytical proof.
title: Exact corner law for circumradii of boundary-random polygonal triangles
